desc: A masterpiece meticulously designed to shatter performance boundaries and redefine precision, the steel frame’s ability to endure the harshest conditions makes it a steadfast companion for countless years of service. The precision-machined steel frame, along with its substantial weight, significantly tames recoil while delivering a level of smoothness in every shot that’s second to none. Whether you’re looking for lightning-fast follow-up shots or laser-like accuracy, the PDP Steel Frame takes your shooting to the next-level.
